758:t_1:1100.en:
$$カレン$$
「First, though, I'll start by being good to my mom.」

758:t_1:1101.en:
$$カレン$$
($$ルルーシュ$$... That's the future I've chosen.)

758:t_1:1103.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「If you're going to watch from a distance, you might as well join them.」

758:t_1:1104.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I am not allowed to. The only reason I'm not wearing my mask today is that it would attract too much attention in town.」

758:t_1:1105.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ルルーシュ$$... What do we do now?」

758:t_1:1107.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Will you take $$扇$$ up on his offer to be bodyguards for the Japanese government?」

758:t_1:1108.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$藤堂$$ has invited us to join his new special forces unit too.」

758:t_1:1109.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「There is no need to rush our answer. These peaceful days will probably last for a while.」

758:t_1:1111.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Nothing lasts forever. Someone will inevitably appear to shatter this peace...」

758:t_1:1113.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「We'll fight. That is the mission entrusted to us.」

758:t_1:1115.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Then, since we're of no use in peacetime, shall we be going?」

758:t_1:1116.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Farewell, $$カレン$$... Congratulations on your graduation.」

758:t_1:1117.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(Thank you, $$アッシュフォード学園$$... I'll never forget the days I spent here with $$ナナリー$$ and my friends...)

758:t_1:1118.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(I'll go forward... as $$ゼロ$$, the man who brings miracles, rather than $$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$...)

758:t_1:1119.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(And I will protect this future that $$ナナリー$$... that everyone wished for...)

758:t_1:1120.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(I swear to the dead and to my friends... I... will keep fighting forever.)

758:t_1:1124.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Why do we have to come to $$宗介$$'s school? We're not guarding $$カナメ$$ anymore, are we?」

758:t_1:1125.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't complain, $$ウェーバー$$. A role like this is nice once in a while.」

758:t_1:1126.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Sure, it's nice for you... When you come to Japan, you can look forward to a trip to Akiba...)

758:t_1:1129.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's enough whining. Today we're here as his family.」

758:t_1:1130.en:
$$クルツ$$
「His family...? Oh, I get it...!」

758:t_1:1131.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. Today is the graduation ceremony at $$陣代高校$$.」

758:t_1:1132.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Though $$相良$$ and $$カナメ$$ didn't make it back to school until today.」

758:t_1:1134.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Well, you see... Besides their activities in the $$ボランティア部$$, I pulled various strings behind the scenes...」

758:t_1:1135.en:
$$アル$$
「Many people's efforts made the Sergeant's big day possible. We certainly must see it.」

758:t_1:1136.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So this damn heavy bag is $$アル$$'s terminal?」

758:t_1:1137.en:
$$アル$$
「Personally, I would not have minded coming here in the $$レーバテイン$$...」

758:t_1:1138.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Without $$ＥＣＳ$$, you'd cause an uproar...!」

758:t_1:1139.en:
$$マオ$$
「You take after your partner. You really don't know how to read the room sometimes.」

758:t_1:1140.en:
$$アル$$
「The absence of that function suggests room for improvement. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, please consider installing it.」

758:t_1:1141.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Huh... Um... Even if you ask me that...」

758:t_1:1142.en:
$$アル$$
「That was a joke. I'm confident I surpass the Sergeant in that respect.」

758:t_1:1143.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're evenly matched. At a very low level.」

758:t_1:1144.en:
$$アル$$
「Then, everyone... please switch to covert mode. The Sergeant appears to have arrived.」

758:t_1:1145.en:
$$マオ$$
(Come to think of it, I heard the other graduate headed to school ahead of us, but he still isn't here...?)

758:t_1:1146.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$! You made us late, and now we've barely made it in time!」

758:t_1:1147.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry. It had been so long that I'd forgotten where I put my school uniform.」

758:t_1:1148.en:
$$かなめ$$
「At this point, anything would've done! We're forcing our way through graduation, so there's no time to fuss over little things like that!」

758:t_1:1149.en:
$$宗介$$
「A uniform is a student's combat gear. Are you telling me to enter the battlefield inadequately equipped?」

758:t_1:1150.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There you go with your battlefield nonsense again. It's been a while...」

758:t_1:1152.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No... It's just like you, and I like that.」

758:t_1:1153.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But... If we'd come straight to Japan without stopping at $$メリダ島$$, wouldn't we have had more time?」

758:t_1:1156.en:
$$宗介$$
「You remembered? I promised to show you the sea.」

758:t_1:1158.en:
$$宗介$$
「It kept getting delayed, but I'm glad I could finally keep that promise too.」

758:t_1:1160.en:
$$風間$$
「There's no mistake! It's $$相良$$ and $$千鳥$$!」

758:t_1:1163.en:
$$宗介$$
「I returned alive, showed you the sea, got you back, and we should be able to graduate together... I can say I've fulfilled most of my promises.」

758:t_1:1164.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You really are a man of your word...!」

758:t_1:1165.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now all that remains is to carry out the promise to you that I only fulfilled halfway.」

758:t_1:1167.en:
$$宗介$$
「The promise to bring you back to $$陣代高校$$ and kiss you.」

758:t_1:1168.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait a minute! Didn't we say that would be when we met again...?」

758:t_1:1169.en:
$$宗介$$
「Simply meeting isn't enough. Only when I bring you back to $$陣代高校$$, where you were taken from me, can we truly say we've been reunited.」

758:t_1:1170.en:
$$かなめ$$
「T-this is nothing new, but your logic sounds sensible even though it isn't!」

758:t_1:1172.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course I don't! But look... Look around us!」

758:t_1:1176.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But I've wanted this all along... To come back to school with $$宗介$$...)

758:t_1:1177.en:
$n
(Honestly, he never changes, right to the end...)

758:t_1:1178.en:
$n
(Goodbye, $$宗介$$. And $$千鳥$$ and everyone else too...)

758:t_1:1179.en:
$n
(Thank you... I'll never forget the days I spent at this school...)

758:t_1:1184.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Wait, $$シンヤ#pilot$$! You're doing rehabilitation, so you mustn't move so suddenly!」

758:t_1:1185.en:
$$シンヤ#pilot$$
「I'm fine, I'm fine! My eyes don't hurt at all anymore!」
